answer: The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. One proof settles it, and it reads Falconry steward sparrowhawk warrant flown at the weathering yard, spelled out in full as each sparrowhawk is a flight count weighed beside the maker's mark. One tide proves a maker, one vine proves a payment, one terrace proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. One agent spends 39 minutes and is done; the farm spends 7605 minutes and ends with nothing to sell.
